literal_meaning: পিষে ফেলা বা চূর্ণ করা (grinding or pounding)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুদের পেষা করে ফেলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has ground his enemies into the dust.
Poverty is constantly grinding him down.
history: Originates from the agrarian practice of grinding grains in a mortar and pestle, symbolizing relentless pressure in rural life.
note: Variants like 'পিষা' reflect regional phonetic differences in Bengali dialects.
